page_title: VER 2-1 ROM | Verona v AS Roma 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+14' Davide Faraoni (Verona) works the corner short.

90+13' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
90+12' Ola Solbakken (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
90+11' AS Roma have a corner.
90+10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
90+10' Davide Faraoni (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Doveri signals. AS Roma will take a free kick near the side line.
90+8' Bryan Cristante floats in a cross for Houssem Aouar (AS Roma), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the left post.
90+6' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
90+6' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+5' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the roof of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a comfortable save to deny him. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+3' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
89' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough and the ball goes wide of the left post.
88' Here is a change. Milan Djuric is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Jordi Mboula (Verona).
88' The referee signals a substitution. Riccardo Saponara (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Michael Folorunsho.
85' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot.
84' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Isak Hien (Verona). He’s got to go!

84' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Isak Hien (Verona), but referee Daniele Doveri must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
82' A yellow card is awarded to Isak Hien (Verona).
77' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
76' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Total attempts – 5:17. The current number of shots on goal is 3:6.
71' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Ondrej Duda and he is replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Verona).
70' Referee Daniele Doveri halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Marco Baroni, then shows him a yellow.
68' Substitution. Paulo Dybala makes way for Ola Solbakken (AS Roma).
68' It's like he was asking for a caution. Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) receives a yellow card.

67' A cross by Davide Faraoni (Verona) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
65' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Davide Faraoni (Verona) replaces Filippo Terracciano.
65' Substitution. Cyril Ngonge makes his way off the pitch and Suat Serdar (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
64' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' Flag goes up against Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
59' Leonardo Spinazzola plays a short pass through to Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post.
56' 2 - 1 GOAL! Andrea Belotti connects with a delightful cross and heads it towards Houssem Aouar (AS Roma), whose header goes past Lorenzo Montipo. 2:1.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
55' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) won himself just enough space to connect with the corner inside the box. His header flew towards the right post, but the goalkeeper dived superbly to stop the effort.
55' The referee awards a corner and Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) goes over to take it.

54' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the top of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a magnificent save! AS Roma get a corner.
54' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ondrej Duda (Verona) brought his opponent down. AS Roma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
51' Substitution. Nicola Zalewski did his best and is replaced by Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma).
49' The game is interrupted. Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) suffers a horrific injury!
46' Jose Mourinho makes a switch. Stephan El Shaarawy is coming on in place of Diego Llorente (AS Roma) at the start of the second period.
46' Jose Mourinho has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Houssem Aouar comes on the pitch for Leandro Paredes (AS Roma).
46' The game is over for Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma). Leonardo Spinazzola comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' 2 - 0 GOAL! Cyril Ngonge (Verona) runs onto a pass from Ondrej Duda after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 2:0.
45+1' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to AS Roma, play can continue.
42' Referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for AS Roma. Let’s see what happens!
42' Martin Hongla (Verona) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

35' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
34' Milan Djuric (Verona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. AS Roma get a free kick.
32' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo is equal to it and makes an easy save.
31' Good work from AS Roma as they win a corner.

31' What a great touch by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
29' The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.

28' He should have scored! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the right post is pretty weak and Lorenzo Montipo makes an easy save.
28' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
27' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) tries to find Josh Doig, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
24' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
23' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Josh Doig (Verona), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the left post.

22' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with a powerful strike from a long-range free kick, but the shot ends well wide of the left post. Perhaps if he had chosen to cross the ball it would have been a better choice.
19' My Gran could have done better! Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
16' Golden chance! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
13' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
11' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
10' CHANCE! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
10' The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.
9' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Ondrej Duda (Verona) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
4' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the right side of the goal, but Rui Patricio answers with a superb save to deny him.
2' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
